title: land --wait-merge waits a bounded time for the code merge request, read from git, then finishes the second pass
goal: backlog.py land accepts --wait-merge SECONDS: after the first pass it polls git (fetch, the merge on main), not the forge CLI, every 60 s up to the bound, then runs the second pass; on timeout it stops with the merge request named; so no session writes its own poll loop of long-context turns. Planted test: a merge that appears after two polls, and a timeout.
